headings.note: Never use Inter for headings. Keep it bold and industrial.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Sharp edges, visible grid lines.
spacing_and_layout.surface_strategy: Containers have border-collapse style layouts. Items have border-r border-b border-border/40.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts via next/font or standard import: Chivo (headings), JetBrains Mono (monospace elements), IBM Plex Sans (body text).
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical iconography. Ensure to install using: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Keep all borders sharp (rounded-none). The design must feel like a structured technical blueprint.
Implement the contact form using Shadcn UI components but heavily override them to match the dark industrial 'Grid Border' aesthetic (no soft shadows, only 1px solid borders).
Ensure the hero overlay has high contrast. The image should be visible but must not conflict with the H1.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for robust testing.
Apply 'Generous Spacing Philosophy': Massive padding between sections (py-24 or py-32).
